summary: Intuit Inc. filed an 8-K announcing fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 results and a quarterly cash dividend of $1.38 per share, payable October 16, 2026 to shareholders of record October 8, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release with standard dividend declaration; no M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation elements are present. The item 2.02 results and dividend are furnished, not filed, and the 8-K includes forward-looking guidance. There is no deal structure, premium, or transactional aspect; the dividend is a routine capital return at the board's discretion. Nothing here triggers special-situations classification.
